content:
The image shows a citrus leaf with visible yellowing and uneven coloration — the leaf has a mottled, pale yellow-green appearance with some areas showing loss of the normal dark green color. This is consistent with blotchy mottle and chlorosis characteristic of Huanglongbing (citrus greening disease).

The leaf does not show any fungal growth, mold, coremia, or postharvest rot symptoms that would indicate Whisker_Mold.
